value.message: Town of Oakville runs Learn to Swim - Preschool (Levels A-E) for ages 3-5, with fall registration opening Tuesday, Aug 11 at 7am (options browsable online from Aug 4) - their site says. YMCA of Oakville also offers Preschool Swim Lessons for 3-5 year olds, though their site doesn't list times or price yet. Want me to check both closer to registration day?
